messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Initiate SIG Pathfinder: follow-up from discovery — clarifying questions

Hi Elena / EdgeHealth team,

Thanks again for taking time to meet earlier — great call. As discussed, we'd like to kick off the vendor security questionnaire process and make sure we scope the right instrument (SIG full vs CAIQ-lite vs custom). A quick recap of what we heard and a few clarifying asks so we can prepare the initial packet: 

- Recap from our discovery: EdgeHealth will evaluate Redwood for embedding/generation features used in clinical triage workflows. You highlighted HIPAA applicability and a need for data residency controls for PHI.
- Primary asks from your side: SOC 2 report, encryption controls for data at rest/in transit, and a list of entitlements for role-based access.

Clarifying questions (please reply inline):
1) SOC 2 status: Is your internal bar SOC 2 Type II completed (latest report) or is a SOC 2 in-progress acceptable for initial assessment? If completed, can you share the 2026/2027 report or an attestation?
2) Questionnaire type: You mentioned preferring a shorter form — is CAIQ-lite sufficient, or do you need the full SIG (Trust) questionnaire completed?
3) Evidence cadence: For items that need evidence (e.g., configuration screenshots, policy docs), what's a realistic timeline for your team to share that — 2 weeks, 4 weeks?
4) Data flow / residency: Can you confirm which environment(s) will process PHI (hosted Redwood API vs Dedicated on customer infra)? If hosted, any specific region constraints (e.g., US-only)?
5) Primary contact for evidence uploads: Please confirm the person we should send the upload instructions to (name + email) and whether you prefer a secure upload link or email attachments.

Attachments I've included: redwood-sig-pathfinder.pdf (starter questionnaire outline) and redwood-evidence-checklist.csv (expected artifacts list). These are starter templates — we'll adapt based on your preference.

Proposed next steps from our side once you confirm: we prepare the tailored questionnaire (CAIQ-lite or SIG full), share a secure evidence upload link, and schedule a 30-min handoff with your security owner to walk the list.

If next week works, Vanessa (cc'd) can coordinate times.

Thanks — looking forward to your guidance.

Best,
Marcus

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the detailed recap and the templates — very helpful. Responding inline to your questions below.

> 1) SOC 2 status
EdgeHealth completed SOC 2 Type II in Q4 2026. I attached the 2026 SOC 2 report excerpt (EdgeHealth_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf). For vendors, we accept a current SOC 2 Type II report; if Redwood prefers, a SOC 2 in-progress + control evidence is also acceptable as an interim step.

> 2) Questionnaire type
We prefer starting with CAIQ-lite to reduce friction; we'll escalate to SIG full if we hit gaps requiring more detail. CAIQ-lite should capture the bulk of our initial risk questions.

> 3) Evidence cadence
We can move on a 3-week cadence for evidence upload if items are clearly mapped and labeled. Our security ops team is small but responsive; if you supply the upload template and a priority list, we can commit to two delivery windows: an initial tranche in ~10 business days and a final tranche ~3 weeks later.

> 4) Data flow / residency
EdgeHealth will process PHI in a US region only — currently AWS us-east-2 and us-west-2 are allowable. We will not accept cross-border processing. For the POC you'll evaluate hosted Redwood API in a dedicated tenant that restricts storage of PHI to US regions. We'll confirm the exact environment once both security and procurement align.

> 5) Primary contact for evidence uploads
Primary: Elena Park <security@edgehealth.com> (Security PM)
Secondary: it-ops@edgehealth.com (Operations)
We prefer a secure upload link (SFTP or secure share) rather than email attachments.

Attachments from our side included: EdgeHealth_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf and EdgeHealth_Contact_List.csv (security + procurement contacts).

One other note: we will require a HIPAA BAA before any PHI processing in prod. Procurement copied on this thread will coordinate BAA steps and timeframe.

If that sounds reasonable, can you: 1) send the CAIQ-lite tailored to Redwood and 2) share the secure upload instructions + preferred timeline? We can schedule the 30-min handoff for next Tue/Wed afternoon PST.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Park
Security Program Manager, EdgeHealth
security@edgehealth.com
